history.summary: Twin mathas at Bakhri village in the Siswan block of Siwan district (Census village code 232737, ~22 km from Siwan town), located near the Daha river. They are the 'samadhi sthals' of two renowned saints, Swami Jaggannath Das ji and his guru Bhagwan Das ji, and are listed on the Siwan district government's places-of-interest page. Thousands of devotees visit every year, with large rushes on auspicious days; pilgrims come from Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal and New Delhi as well as Saran, Gopalganj, Jehanabad and Ara in Bihar. UNVERIFIED: no reliable source documents the founding date or the saints' period. CSV town 'Siwan' corrected to Bakhri (village), district Siwan. Coordinates approximate (village-level). No verified photograph of these mathas was found after two image searches.

name: Anand Bagh Math and Sunder Bagh Math
town_description: Bakhri is a small agrarian village in the Siswan block of Siwan district, Bihar, about 22 km from Siwan town (Census village code 232737). It is best known for the Anand Bagh and Sunder Bagh mathas, the samadhi shrines of two revered saints, which draw devotees from several states. The mathas stand near the Daha river.
